summary: Bitzero Holdings Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a corporate update released September 1, 2026. The update covers full repayment of its $25 million debt facility, release of related liens, ongoing bitcoin mining cash flows, and construction progress at Norway and Finland sites with power readiness expected for 110MW and 80MW respectively. Lease discussions are ongoing with capacity available Q4 2027 to Q1 2028. This is routine operational and balance-sheet disclosure, not a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No transaction terms or strategic alternatives were announced.
